note: CurseForge-only optional addons cannot be redistributed in Git due to license/API limits. Run sync_instance.bat --with-optional (or --with-all-optional) to download them locally, or drop legally downloaded Forge 1.20.1 JARs into this folder.

addons.name: Realistic Walkie-Talkie
addons.author: Toni_Carter_Company_Mods_Inc
addons.notes: Sole radio mod in Long Haul Legacy 2.0 (Flaton's walkie-talkie removed). Frequency-tuned (100.0-999.9 MHz) Simple Voice Chat radios with radio audio effects, squelch, /walkie, /radio, and text channel support. Requires ToniCore (tonicore >= 1.0.0) library from CurseForge. Preconfigured in overrides/config/walkietalkies-server.properties; early Chapter 01 quest + /lh radio kit grant starter radios dynamically when loaded.

addons.name: ToniCore
addons.author: Toni_Carter_Company_Mods_Inc
addons.notes: Mandatory core library (>= 1.0.0, Forge 1.20.1) required by Realistic Walkie-Talkie (walkietalkies). Download alongside walkietalkies-forge-1.3.0-1.20.1.jar.

addons.name: The Furry Project
addons.notes: CurseForge-only Forge 1.20.1 mod (All Rights Reserved). Download from CurseForge and drop into optional-mods/ or your launcher's mods/ folder.
